payload.title: self_revert.run_self_revert_producer has callers only inside two cycle phases and none in the CLI, and the CLI has no verb for the post-merge CI scan or the change-outcome evaluation either, so a deployment that runs ARIA step by step instead of through the cycle never scans for or reverts a bad ARIA merge
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_revert.py:930-975 (run_self_revert_producer, the one producer of the revert and the self-merge freeze, with the two triggers named at :187-189)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:1295-1316 (the change-outcome phase calls it for TRIGGER_CHANGE_OUTCOME)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:1683-1690 (the pr_ci_scan phase calls it for TRIGGER_POST_MERGE_CI)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:1278 (the change-outcome phase function; the cycle is its only caller)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:669 (the only mention of a revert in the CLI is a comment; the file holds no import of self_revert, evaluate_change_outcomes or scan_merged_own_prs)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md make it automatic (tier 2) applied to a safety brake: the producer that freezes self-merge and reverts a bad ARIA merge must be reachable from every entry point that can merge, not from one phase table
payload.notes: git grep at origin/main db10640f6 finds run_self_revert_producer called only at cycle.py:1306 and cycle.py:1685. A deployment that drives the kernel through CLI verbs one step at a time (pr create, merge, state publish) has no verb that reads post-merge CI, evaluates the change outcome or calls the producer, so a merged ARIA change that goes red is never frozen or reverted unless a full cycle also runs. Plan items F3.4 and F3.3b own the merge-outcome side of this chain. Close condition: A CLI verb (for example self-revert run with --trigger) calls run_self_revert_producer with the same issue-writer selection the cycle uses, or a written operator rule states that the cycle is the only entry and a test pins that statement; either way a test pins that the CLI reaches the producer (or that its absence is the documented rule). Plan row: F3.4 and F3.3b. Verified at origin/main db10640f6.
